# MegaMemory upstream reference

This branch pins MegaMemory as a Git submodule for architecture review and selective integration only.

- Upstream repository: https://github.com/0xK3vin/MegaMemory
- Pinned upstream commit: e0bb3c270d7fb4f6f280ae4685e0c538eb225d93
- Upstream package version at that commit: 1.6.2
- License: MIT
- Purpose: compare and selectively port mature retrieval, embedding, graph, installer, and explorer ideas into Context State Manager without replacing its evidence/provenance truth layer.

Do not merge this branch into `main` merely to vendor MegaMemory. The submodule exists as a stable source reference for the ongoing architecture audit.
